assessments.reasoning: The ON-unit clause distinguishes establishing the action from executing it upon the enabled condition. The scope section provides the precise dynamic extension and termination and restoration rules.

challenge.method: Compared execution of ON with raising the condition, the null and SYSTEM alternatives, dynamic child override and restoration, and a same-invocation override.
challenge.results: An explicit ON-unit stays established around dynamically descended blocks until overridden or terminated. The differing restoration outcomes are consistent with the frozen claim’s conditional while-established phrasing.

limitations: The enabled condition is required when it is raised. Another ON, REVERT and block termination delimit the established association; return and diagnostic behavior remain separate.
